verses.text: The fear of YHWH [is] the beginning of knowledge; wisdom and instruction fools have despised.

verses.text: Wisdom calls aloud in the street; in the open squares she gives forth her voice.

verses.text: “Until when, O simple ones, will you⁺ love simplicity, and those mocking delight themselves in mockery, and the foolish ones hate knowledge?
